scope.contentInspection: File sizes and hashes, public inventory and manifest. Forbidden credential/environment filenames would be reported without opening their content.

limits: No browser behavior, CSP enforcement or HTTP routes were exercised by this audit.
Hashes demonstrate identity with the supplied public build, not the provenance of that build against application source.
Client bundles may retain dormant payment/provider/API strings; this inventory does not claim their absence.
CSP and HTTP review is performed separately.
